sources.stated_purpose: Non-sensitive administrative inquiries within documented county legal remit and jurisdiction.
sources.limitations: Official department page and staff directory publish this general department address; the same directory also publishes county.counsel@nevadacountyca.gov as the County Counsel role address. Retain only one canonical email; confirm which channel is appropriate. County counsel represents the county, not a private complainant. Do not infer legal filing, service-of-process or independent complaint intake authorization. Confirm current mailbox, role and remit before use. Deliverability not tested.
